title: Story Vs. Telling Part 1
summary: Divya admits she's not sure the podcast has ever felt successful, and Kahran pushes on whether the problem is the story being told or the way it's being told. They work through what it means to make something deeply authentic but not reach a wider audience — referencing the beat poets, friend-of-friends with 110k Instagram followers, and Remy Siu's theatre with no venue — and start to land on the how, not the what.
topics: finding an audience for the work
going to existing community gathering places

intents.display: to think about why the right work isn't reaching the right audience
